For example, a transaction dated 2026-01-03 with all other conditions true yields false originally but OUT_OF_SCOPE after lowering. This changes the declared Boolean meaning. evidence.quote: Starting 30 November 2024, ie, after the parallel run period, applications and submissions of investment products administered by IPD must be submitted via e-IP.
During this period, the SFC continues to accept applications and submissions via existing channels.
To facilitate these enhancements, the SFC will extend the parallel run period of e-IP by one month to 29 November 2024.
